originality.rationale: Delivered result is the admission fallback, not the admitted target. Target required per-floor-diagram nodal real-lift counts via patchworking sign vectors + non-liftability obstruction + maximal lift linked to a diagram; none delivered (no sign vectors, d=4 real sum wrong under diagram-only rule, explicit polynomials not shown to lift any tropical diagram). Remaining fallback (complex census N3=12/N4=620, W3=8, genus-bound maximality, arbitrary nodal cubic/quartic) is substantively covered by prior work: Kontsevich numbers 12/620 known since 1994; W3=8 Welschinger 2005; floor-diagram method and general GW/Welschinger floor formula are Brugalle-Mikhalkin 0812.3354 and Fomin-Mikhalkin; lattice-path correspondence Mikhalkin math/0209253; maximal node counts 1 and 3 are immediate genus-formula consequences pa=1,3; nodal cubic y^2=x^2(x+1) is a textbook exercise. Per-diagram (edges,weights,nu) breakdown is a mechanical application of the known labeled-floor algorithm to d=3,4, not a new inequality, object, or boundary; the d=4 +6 discrepancy note characterizes failure of a coarse odd-weight proxy, not a new enumerative theorem. No nearest-source search can establish novelty because novelty would require the missing real-liftability inequality, which is absent. Hence originality FAIL; per instructions originality failure is never repairable.

value.rationale: Judging the strongest self-contained fallback headline separately from the unfinished real census: certified N3=12/N4=620 recomputation + W3=8 + explicit 1- and 3-nodal curves with genus maximality. This is textbook restatement + arbitrary witness, not independently retrievable value. N3,N4,W3 values are long-known constants; per-diagram nu/cC values are mechanically implied by running the published floor algorithm and are reproducible in seconds, not unknown invariants motivated before computation that a future researcher would need to look up. Maximality is mechanically implied by pa-delta>=0. The specific quartic coefficients (-6y^2+5y^3-2y^4+3xy^2+xy^3+4x^2-2x^2y^2-4x^3+x^4 at (0,0),(1,1),(2,0)) define an arbitrary rational 3-nodal quartic; any such curve suffices, precise coefficients were not motivated before computation and have no stated downstream use; certification (Hessian/mod-7/grid replay) alone does not rescue an arbitrary object per the value standard. The honest d=4 discrepancy localization and audit-template scripts are useful transparency but are failure documentation and replayability, not a new citable extremal fact. No general criterion or completed census is demanded, but the narrow data offered do not meet the 'motivated natural object + unknown non-mechanical value + foreseeable retrieval need' test for a valuable exact datum.
